providers.reason: Despite a broader tech selloff, CrowdStrike surged 14% to all-time highs this week. It remains a dominant cybersecurity leader, recently named the only 'Customers' Choice' by Gartner for Identity Threat Detection. Increased AI-driven attack surfaces are driving expanded security budgets, though its rich valuation requires continued flawless execution.
providers.risk: Extremely high valuation (39x P/S) makes it vulnerable to further spikes in Treasury yields or growth-stock rotations.

providers.reason: Cybersecurity is the market's strongest thematic tailwind as AI-safety warnings lift security-spending expectations. CRWD surged ~14% Monday and added 3% Tuesday to about $242, backed by 25% ARR growth and record net-new ARR. Group leadership and momentum favor continuation over a 2–5 day window.
providers.risk: The sharp single-day pop leaves the stock extended; any profit-taking in the crowded cybersecurity trade or a hawkish Fed surprise could trigger a fast pullback.
